messages:
sasha: Heads-up — customer (ent-142) asked for a clear upgrade/migration path where they run customer-managed edge networking (NAT + egress proxy) for on-prem Redwood. Need to sync on launch criteria for v1 of customer-managed networking.
raj: Quick q — do they want operator mode (service account + RBAC) or long-lived static creds on their egress proxy? that affects rollback complexity.
oliver: Also need to decide whether we mandate an egress annotation on pods or support cluster-wide NAT rules. Different UX + docs work either way.
amanda: Draft launch criteria proposal:
• supported: operator-managed service account + short-lived tokens
• fallback: a hosted fallback route for critical requests
• migration docs: step-by-step rollback and a dry-run mode
• canary: 10% traffic for first 48h
• monitoring: upgrade health-checks surfaced in Console
raj: I prefer operator-managed SA. static creds = security landmine. for rollback we also need a KV-cache invalidation step — otherwise sessions hit mismatched models.
sasha: +1 on operator SA. For customers that cannot run operators, we should support a documented manual flow but mark it as unsupported for SLA.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot created ticket PROJ-1423: "customer-network-affinity-migration" and assigned to raj.
raj: quick config snippet for operator annotation (example):
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: redwood-edge-sa
  annotations:
    redwood.com/egress-mode: "operator"
```
oliver: Important: need network-team signoff on whether we require customers to expose ports for health probes or we support agent-side probing. also cs-ida — please confirm what ent customers expect for upgrade windows.
cs-ida: For Ent customers we've seen preference for a 2–4 hour maintenance window with clear rollback comms. they want pre-upgrade validation checklist and post-upgrade runbook.
amanda: Ok — add to criteria: pre-upgrade validation script + post-upgrade smoke tests; Console should show an "upgrade readiness" flag. I'll file DOCS-89 for the runbook.
raj: I'll draft a short design doc listing operator lifecycle, token rotation, and KV-cache invalidation steps. pinging @sasha, @amanda for review. target EOD Thurs for draft.
sasha: Great. Next steps:
- raj: design doc by EOD Thurs (owner)
- amanda: docs runbook skeleton by Mon (owner)
- oliver: network-team signoff target next Tue
- cs-ida: confirm maintenance-window wording for customer comms
We'll use PROJ-1423 to track. If no blockers, aim to include v1 in next minor (runtime v0.9.3). :thumbsup:
